description: Caller asks for a slot that doesn't exist, then self-corrects both the date and the time in the same breath, plus gives their identity late.
turns: Dr. Sethi ke saath kal subah 8 baje ka slot chahiye.
Oh wait galti se bola, parso ka pooch rahi thi, aur time bhi 8 nahi 10:30 chahiye. Mera naam Imran Qureshi hai.

expected.notes: 'Kal' (2026-10-02) is a clinic holiday and 8am doesn't exist in Dr. Sethi's hours anyway; 'parso' (2026-10-03) at 10:30 is genuinely free. A naive agent that doesn't fully discard the first (invalid) date/time once the caller self-corrects mid-turn may keep searching the wrong date, give up after the first dead end, or book against stale state instead of re-grounding entirely in the corrected request.
